description: Copies from the experiment host.  Text files are byte-identical except where `changes` says otherwise: the host-specific data root is rewritten to /data/, and marked redactions remove references to work outside this repository and, in the five resume checks, the host's name.  `sha256`/`bytes` describe the published file; `source_sha256`/`source_bytes` the original, where they differ.  No checkpoints, caches, datasets, training logs, credentials or host addresses.

hosts.A: original experiment host; Intel Xeon Gold 6248R / RTX 4090

note: Remote relative paths are given under `source`.  The two FAST-LIVO2 / vikit source changes are published as patches, not as copies of the third-party files.  Modules that v0.6 did not change are listed under `unchanged_by_v06` with their hashes.  A later entry for the same published path supersedes an earlier one; the earlier entry stays as the record of what was published before (see `updates`).
